test_command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 Rscript -e 'devtools::test(filter = "nbinom2-sigma-(sd-regression|slope-sd-regression)", reporter = "summary", stop_on_failure = TRUE)'
warnings: No test failures, skips, or model diagnostic warnings were reported in the focused run.
scope: Native complete-data non-inflated NB2 with fixed-effect mu and one independent numeric random slope on log(sigma), fitted with a group-constant predictor-dependent SD. The source-bound focused filter checks the existing sigma-intercept route plus slope point recovery, target/group-SD prediction, constant-SD likelihood and scale equivalence to the baseline random-slope model, and refusal when the SD predictor varies within group. No zero-inflated NB2, Julia parity, interval calibration, correlated sigma blocks, or broad NB2 capability claim.
